keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Own Goal by Gabriele Calvani, Frosinone. AC Milan 1, Frosinone 0.
Delay in match (AC Milan).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! AC Milan 2, Frosinone 0. Gonçalo Ramos (AC Milan) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Adrien Rabiot following a fast break.
Goal! AC Milan 2, Frosinone 1. Patrizio Masini (Frosinone) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
Giorgio Cittadini (Frosinone) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Giacomo Calò (Frosinone) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, AC Milan 2, Frosinone 1.
Substitution, AC Milan. Ardon Jashari replaces Davide Bartesaghi.
Substitution, Frosinone. Wisdom Amey replaces Giorgio Cittadini.
Goal! AC Milan 3, Frosinone 1. Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Adrien Rabiot.
Substitution, AC Milan. Alphadjo Cisse replaces Gonçalo Ramos.
Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) is shown the yellow card.

Goal! AC Milan 4, Frosinone 1. Alphadjo Cisse (AC Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Diego Moreira following a fast break.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Substitution, Frosinone. Daniel Bîrligea replaces Giorgi Kvernadze.
Substitution, Frosinone. Aleksa Terzic replaces Enzo Tchato.
Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! AC Milan 5, Frosinone 1. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a fast break.
Substitution, AC Milan. Strahinja Pavlovic replaces Sankhoun Diawara.
Substitution, AC Milan. Pervis Estupiñán replaces Yunus Musah.
Substitution, Frosinone. Alessio Zerbin replaces Romano Schmid.
Substitution, Frosinone. Anouar El Azzouzi replaces Giacomo Calò.
Delay in match because of an injury Daniel Bîrligea (Frosinone).
Substitution, AC Milan. Omari Hutchinson replaces Christian Pulisic.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Alphadjo Cisse (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, AC Milan 5, Frosinone 1.
